# @stapel/core 0.25.2

Stapel frontend runtime (L0): typed fetch with the Stapel error envelope, auth token/refresh seams, verification-403 interception, TanStack Query layer with per-user persistence, i18n engine, config provider, breakpoints hook.

No backend Django module of its own — this is the frontend RUNTIME every @stapel/<module>-react pair is built on top of: client + error envelope, session/refresh seam, TanStack Query layer, i18n engine, analytics seam, flow-machine primitive, encrypted repositories. A pair depends on this and never re-implements what is exported here.

## Analytics events (typed; defineEvent → events.json, drift-gated)
- (no app defineEvent() in this pair — its analytic events are the
  auto-instrumented flow funnels below)

## Flow funnels (auto-instrumented: flow.<id>.<step> {phase})

```tsx
// Typed event + tracked() click (the one right way; §3.1).
const planSelected = defineEvent({
  name: "pricing.plan.selected",
  description: "User picked a plan",
  props: { plan: prop.oneOf(["free", "pro", "team"], "Plan code") },
});
const { tracked } = useTracked();
<Button onClick={tracked(planSelected, { plan }, startCheckout)} />
// A click that STEPS a flow machine is already instrumented — mark it
// data-analytics="flow" instead; tracked() on top double-counts (§3.2).
```

## Snippets
```tsx
// One-provider setup (StapelConfigProvider + QueryClientProvider + I18nProvider).
const client = createStapelClient({ baseUrl, getAccessToken });
<StapelProvider client={client} queryClient={queryClient} i18n={i18n}>
  <App />
</StapelProvider>
```
```tsx
// Error narrowing — never a cast (stapel/no-raw-error-shape).
if (isStapelApiError(err)) return <Alert>{t(err.code, err.params)}</Alert>;
```
